# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Qtap, please report it privately. Do **not** create a public issue.

- Email: [security@qpoint.io](mailto:security@qpoint.io)
- Please include as much detail as possible to help us reproduce and address the issue quickly.
- We aim to respond within 10 business days.
- Please do not send us binaries.

After triage, we will work with you on a coordinated disclosure timeline if needed. Once resolved, we will publish an advisory and credit the reporter if desired.

## Further Reading
- [GitHub Security Advisories](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories)
- [Coordinated Disclosure](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
